ns2:section.sectionText: Engineering in Global Environment - Introduction to evaluating multiple impacts of engineering decisions, especially choice of services for basic needs and societal development. Local and global environmental and human health impacts; social and economic considerations. Quantitative and qualitative analysis is applied in two case studies. Prerequisites: CEE 201, CEE 202, PHYS 211 or equivalent.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Civil Engineering major(s). Not intended for Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
